construction: 70 parts in 8 steps. Steps 3–5: 1×1 bricks with studs on four sides on the trunk. Step 6: two `christmas-tree-step6-10` face children on opposite sides. Step 7: two `christmas-tree-step11-16` children. Step 8: the star child.
interfaces: Stud directions: 70 parts, 15 up; 11, 11, 12 and 12 on the four sides; 9 angled.
lesson: A radial core with identical faces, for round or conical shapes.
parent_context: Beside the Gingerbread House in `10267 - main.ldr`.
reuse_notes: Repeat one face child on each side of a four-sided stud core; change the face to change the silhouette.
